Mrunali Mhaske

 Pune, India | mrunalimhaske11@gmail.com | +91-8149458552 | 

www.linkedin.com/in/mrunali-mhaske--42682a167

Professional Summary

6+ years of experience in Data Engineering and Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) with strong expertise in building, deploying, and monitoring ML pipelines across AWS and distributed systems. Skilled in Python, PySpark, MLflow, Airflow, Docker, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Generative AI frameworks (LangChain, RAG, Vector Databases, and LLMs like Sonnet 3.5) with hands-on experience in ML algorithms, Scikit-learn, and data-driven automation. Proven ability to bridge the gap between data engineering and AI/ML lifecycle, delivering scalable, production-ready ML and GenAI solutions.

Technical Skills

Programming: Python, PySpark, SQL

Generative AI & LLMs: LangChain, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases (FAISS, Pinecone), OpenAI/Sonnet 3.5 LLM integration

ML/DL Frameworks: Scikit-learn, ML Algorithms, Pandas, NumPy

MLOps & Workflow: MLflow, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Jenkins

Cloud & Big Data: AWS (S3, Lambda, EMR, Athena, SageMaker, Bedrock), Spark

Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL

Messaging & APIs: RabbitMQ, REST APIs

Professional Experience

Dassault Systèmes – Senior Data Engineer (AI/ML focus)

Regulated Content Management System (RCM)

Aug 2022 – Present | Pune, India

Designed and implemented an automated ML pipeline for document classification using XGBoost and feature engineering in PySpark.

Deployed ML workflows on AWS (S3, Lambda, EMR) with containerization in Docker.

Integrated Airflow for pipeline orchestration and MLflow for model tracking & experiment management.

Developed model monitoring dashboards tracking accuracy, precision, recall, and F1- score.

Optimized PySpark ETL jobs reducing processing time by 30%.



Mazars – Data Engineer

Banking Sector

Feb 2022 – Aug 2022 | Pune, India

Worked on designing and implementing offer release workflows for a leading banking client.

Gathered eligibility and exclusion rules from business stakeholders and translated them into optimized Athena SQL queries to extract base data from large-scale datasets.

Developed and automated rule coding logic to generate accurate customer-specific payloads.

Leveraged Apache Airflow for orchestrating workflows, creating and triggering multiple payloads to ensure timely delivery of personalized offers to customers.

Tata Consultancy Services – Data Engineer / ML Pipeline Developer

Fraud Analytics for Banks

Jan 2021 – Feb 2022 | Pune, India

Built fraud analytics pipeline for financial data with feature engineering, variable creation, and outlier handling.

Automated model training & evaluation workflow (classification models with scikit- learn).

Deployed ML scripts into production workflows integrated with PySpark.

Enhanced fraud detection model accuracy by 15% via feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning.

Pragma Software Systems

Jul 2019 – Dec 2020 | Pune, India

Developed insurance claim processing workflows with database integration.

Implemented data migration pipelines and automated reporting using SQL & Python.

Collaborated with business teams to transition from legacy systems to modern data- driven platforms.

Research & Projects

Hugging Robot for Analyzing Human Behaviour – Published in IJARCS, Volume 8, Issue 5, 2017. Applied AI to interpret human emotional response using behavior data.

RAG-based Question Answering System (Personal Project) – Developed an end-to-end GenAI pipeline using LangChain, FAISS vector database, and Sonnet 3.5 LLM to enable context-aware retrieval and question answering over domain-specific PDFs. Integrated embedding generation, vector search, and LLM orchestration with MLflow tracking and Docker-based deployment.



MLflow Integration Demo (Personal Project) – End-to-end ML pipeline for classification with model tracking, versioning, and deployment in Docker.

AWS SageMaker Mini Project (POC) – Trained and deployed XGBoost model on SageMaker with model monitoring.

Certifications

AWS Certified Machine Learning – (in progress)

Python for Data Science – Coursera

Cyber Security Foundation (TCS)

PHP/MySQL (NIIT)

Education

B.E. (Computer Engineering) – Pune University
